name: FIFA World Cup
description: The pinnacle of men's international football, contested by national teams from every confederation.

name: FIFA Women's World Cup
description: The premier international tournament for women's national teams.

name: FIFA Club World Cup
frequency: Every 4 years (revamped to a 32-team format in 2025)
description: FIFA's global club competition, bringing together the champions of each confederation. Ran as a smaller annual event from 2000-2023 before its 2025 expansion to 32 teams.

name: Africa Cup of Nations
description: Africa's national team championship, commonly known as AFCON.

name: AFC Asian Cup
description: Asia's national team championship, the second-oldest continental football tournament in the world after the Copa América.

name: UEFA European Championship
description: Europe's national team championship, known simply as the Euros.

name: UEFA Champions League
description: Europe's top club competition, contested by the continent's highest-finishing domestic sides.

name: CONCACAF Gold Cup
description: The national team championship of North America, Central America and the Caribbean.

name: OFC Nations Cup
description: Oceania's national team championship, historically dominated by New Zealand and Australia (who left for the AFC in 2006).

name: Copa América
description: The oldest continental national team championship in the world. Known as the South American Championship until 1967; the tournament resumed in 1975 under its current name.

name: Liga Profesional de Fútbol
description: The top flight of Argentine club football, the oldest league competition in the Americas.

name: Campeonato Brasileiro Série A
description: The top flight of Brazilian club football, commonly known as the Brasileirão.

name: Categoría Primera A
frequency: Annual, split into Apertura and Finalización tournaments
description: The top flight of Colombian club football, played as two independent short tournaments each year rather than one full-season table.

name: Premier League
description: The top flight of English club football, decided over 38 rounds of matches each season.

name: Ligue 1
description: The top flight of French club football.

name: Bundesliga
description: The top flight of German club football.

name: La Liga
description: The top flight of Spanish club football.

name: Uruguayan Primera División
description: The top flight of Uruguayan club football.
